title: tockmox ai-node desired.yaml v1
description: The GENERATED half of an AI node's desired state: ai-nodes/<id>/desired.yaml. `python -m app.ai_nodes render` derives it from the site's inferenceNodes and modelLifecycle blocks and the node's ai-node.yaml; it is committed, and CI fails when it is stale. It is never edited by hand: the converger applies it and reports its inputsSha256. Unknown keys are refused at every level.

schema.description: The file's schema id and version.

aiNodeId.description: The node's id; equal to ai-nodes/<id>/ and an inferenceNodes node id.

inputsSha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace) of the inputs this file was derived from: the node's inferenceNodes slice, its routes, the joined catalog entries, the gateway's CIDRs and the node's ai-node.yaml. The exact projection is in tockmox-ui/app/ai_nodes.py. The converger reports it as desired_sha256.

instances.description: One engine instance per inferenceNodes endpoint that has at least one route, sorted by id.

firewall.description: The host firewall. Engine ports are open only to the gateway's source networks, exporter ports to the scrape networks, administration ports to the administrators.

exporterAllowFrom.description: inferenceNodes.gateway.scrapeCidrs when set, else engineAllowFrom. Never empty.

exporters.description: Telemetry exporters and their ports, from ai-node.yaml telemetry. macmon is macOS only.

modelsPresent.description: Every catalog entry at stage candidate or promoted that is routed to this node, sorted by model. The model_sync role makes these present at their pinned revisions; a model that leaves this list is removed after models.retain.keepUnreferencedDays.

artifact.description: Where a model's files come from, pinned. huggingface: a repository and a 40-hex commit. ollama: name:tag and the manifest digest. modelkit: an OCI reference and its digest.

engine.description: An engine id from the UI's ENGINES table (tockmox-ui/app/nodes.py).

port.description: The port in the endpoint's url.

models.description: Every model routed to this endpoint, sorted by model. mlx-lm, llama-server and the other one-model-per-process engines have exactly one.

model.description: The upstream model id the engine knows (the route's model). No spaces, no "..".

aliases.description: The gateway aliases routed to this model on this endpoint, sorted.

contextTokens.description: The context length, from the route's params.max_input_tokens or params.num_ctx (the largest across aliases); null when none is set.

gateway.description: eval when every alias on the endpoint ends in -next (a candidate, reachable only through the eval gateway); production otherwise. A mixed endpoint is refused by the renderer.

secretRef.description: The endpoint's auth.secretRef (the NAME of a secret, never its value); null when the engine takes no token.
